Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the candid inventory of where AuroraCloud is on embedding search and vector ops. Quick recap and the obvious next step so we keep momentum: 

Summary of discussion
- Primary goal: reduce embedding cost per query and standardize inference across cloud regions.
- Key constraints: low 99th‑pct latency for search completions, SOC2 evidence readiness in 90 days, and evaluation on 1–2 production queries.
- Stakeholders: Product (Liam), Security (TBD), Infra/Platform (you mentioned an infra lead).

Proposed next step
We recommend a focused 30‑minute product demo + short Q&A (no longer than 10 min Q&A) to show: live inference demo, cost/latency dashboard, and suggested rollout plan. Can you please pick 2–3 windows that work for the core stakeholders? Below are three slots that work for our team (all are US‑Pacific times):

Option A — Tue Aug 10 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
Option B — Wed Aug 11 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
Option C — Thu Aug 12 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT (useful if your EU teammates join)

If none of these work, share 2 slots from your side and we'll match. Also let us know who from your side should join (security / infra / product) so I can include the right folks from Redwood: Dev (technical lead) and Tessa (solutions lead).

Attachments
- Redwood_Product_OnePager.pdf — short capabilities/quant economics
- Draft_Agenda_30min.docx — proposed flow and roles

Next steps
1) Reply with preferred slot(s) and participants.
2) We'll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read (single slide + sample queries).

Thanks — looking forward,

— Olga
